mission: collector-redeploy takes each collector's commit from the fleet pins (owner-visible fix 2026-10-22): the first apply restored snkrdunk-collector to the PR #103 image a504e47 because the committed receipt chain never received the PR #180 SNKR delivery, and Verify staging merge failed 'Unexpected deployed SNKR source or schedule'. Pins now come from docs/agent/STAGING_FLEET.json (snkr_component ff01956, yuyu_reader_component 2bcbe90), the same pins Verify checks; the source is the newest redeployable deployment with that pin's exact-commit marker. Owner-gated as before.

impacts.reason: fleet_pins() reads STAGING_FLEET.json and refuses a missing or non-SHA pin; pinned_source() returns the newest redeployable deployment carrying the pin's exact-commit marker and an image digest; plan() takes the digest from that source. Receipts no longer read. Apply path (collector_variables.restore) unchanged.

Pins equal the fleet state and a 'merge' pin refuses; the source skips other commits, image-less and non-redeployable records and takes the newest pinned copy; the plan carries pin, source and digest and reports a missing source.
collector-redeploy uses fleet pins; why receipts are not used; Verify needs one natural cron run afterwards.

resources: Railway staging collectors (10), only through an owner-approved ops-write apply
routes: Railway GraphQL deploymentRedeploy(usePreviousImageTag:true) on the fleet-pinned image only, through collector_variables.restore
impact.deployment_impact: Merging changes nothing live. The next owner-approved apply puts snkrdunk-collector back on the ff01956 (PR #180) image and redeploys the shards on their unchanged 2bcbe90 image.

recovery.procedure: Native revert PR with its own mission file; a collector on a wrong image is restored with scripts/collector_variables.py --restore --expect-digest <digest> or a corrected dry run.
recovery.trigger: A dry run shows a source whose commit differs from the fleet pin, or Verify reports an unexpected collector source after an apply.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change.

verification.observation_window: Dry run shows snkrdunk-collector at ff01956; apply; Verify staging merge re-run after one natural cron cycle.
